name: explore-spec-clarify-plan-oracle
description: Read-only premium workflow with repo exploration and a clarification gate before planning.

steps.task: Explore repository context for goal: {goal}. Identify relevant files, current behavior, gaps, and evidence only.
steps.context: Chain {chain}, step {step_id}; original ask: {original_user_ask}; previous steps: {previous_step_ids}

steps.task: Convert the goal into a testable spec using prior exploration evidence from: {previous_step_ids}. Goal: {goal}.
steps.context: Chain {chain}, step {step_id}; original ask: {original_user_ask}; previous steps: {previous_step_ids}

steps.task: Review the repo-grounded spec for goal: {goal}. Score clarity and decide if planning is allowed. If clarity_score < 70 or BLOCKED, return allow_plan=no.
mustDo: Block planning when acceptance criteria are not testable
steps.context: Chain {chain}, step {step_id}; original ask: {original_user_ask}; previous steps: {previous_step_ids}

steps.task: Plan only if clarification allows planning for goal: {goal}. Use prior evidence from: {previous_step_ids}. State assumptions and stop if allow_plan=no.
steps.expectedOutcome: Bounded plan or explicit stop decision if clarification blocks planning
steps.context: Chain {chain}, step {step_id}; original ask: {original_user_ask}; previous steps: {previous_step_ids}

steps.task: Review the clarified repo-grounded plan for goal: {goal}. Return PASS/FAIL/WARN and no_ship without editing.
steps.expectedOutcome: Oracle verdict on whether the clarified plan is safe
mustDo: Check plan against spec and clarification
Flag missing validation or unsafe scope
steps.context: Chain {chain}, step {step_id}; original ask: {original_user_ask}; previous steps: {previous_step_ids}
